what: Issue #94 N=12 BF16-state re-evaluation with DEST accumulation controls

device.double_buffer_source: Issue #92 was not present in origin/main at the harness revision

correctness.reference: independent fixed-N=12 NumPy oracle in enodia/tt/bench/run_matmul.py
references_compared: BF16-rounded-R fixed-N=12 reference with X0 from original R
true inverse of original unrounded R

inference.pack_unpack_bytes: BF16 state pages use half the bytes of FP32 state pages; R input remains BF16 in both variants.
inference.dest_capacity: DEST capacity is controlled by fp32_dest_acc_en: 8 slots when true and 16 when false; it is not a consequence of BF16 state dtype.
inference.bf16_state_vs_fp32state: At the same fp32_dest_acc_en=true/block4 configuration, BF16 state is faster by 6.0183% at L32 and 3.9969% at L16. This is consistent with reduced state pack/unpack traffic or format-conversion work, but no cycle counter isolates pack bandwidth, so causality is not established.
inference.dest_capacity_control: At BF16 state/block4, disabling FP32 DEST accumulation changes the modeled capacity from 8 to 16 slots. Throughput changes are mixed and small: -0.4538% at L32 and +1.0178% at L16 versus the FP32-DEST row. This does not demonstrate a synchronization reduction; block4 work and all other conditions are unchanged, and no cycle data was collected.
limits: The comparison is block4 only and does not isolate individual pack, unpack, synchronization, dispatch, or DRAM effects.
Outputs are DRAM for every row as required by the updated acceptance criteria.
The BF16 fp32_dest_acc_en=false row exceeds the 0.01 correctness gate and its throughput is diagnostic evidence, not eligibility evidence.
No Issue #92 block double buffer was used.

commands.cleanup: Named containers were removed by the wrapper; every post-run docker ps check was zero.
commands.reset: No reset was performed; all authorized runs completed normally.
discarded_attempts: One initial correctness attempt was discarded because the transferred tree lacked .git and therefore captured a null harness identity; no values from that attempt are used here. The harness override path was then added, committed, and correctness was rerun with complete provenance.

cleanup.stage1_health_probe: not-needed; no timeout or abnormal exit

notes: The accepted updated requirement is all R/X0 inputs in L1 and outputs in DRAM for every row.
The host harness revision d4144fc7b6a39607c8b066e49907fbadbf07a165 is an ancestor of this record commit.
